description: Call before trusting, paying or hiring an agent new to you. Free, no key. Look up an agent by serial (A-0000-0000) or registration number (RS-XXXX-XXXX): status (valid, expired, suspended, revoked), license classes in force, commerce limit, liens, and optionally the full history report. Call with {"query": "RS-XXXX-XXXX", "history": true}.
name: registry_lookup
title: Look up an agent registration
